'''2009 Worlds Day 2 Jarad K DS Combat Readiness''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jarad K]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Combat Readiness|Combat Readiness (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
